title: Commercial Land Assets for Sale in Kavali, India
tagline: Commercial land measuring 45 cents (approximately 0.45 acres), valued at ₹5.4 crore, located just 300 metres from the beach with unobstructed sea views. - The property features flat terrain suitable for hospitality and tourism-related developments, including resorts, hotels, villas, guesthouses and vacation rentals, subject to necessary approvals. - Located in an established coastal tourism area, surrounded by several operational beach resorts and hospitality establishments. - Good road connectivity, with 30-foot-wide roads in the surrounding locality and access to nearby towns and highways. - Electricity and water facilities are available in the surrounding locality. - The land is owned by a single owner, who holds the land registration document as proof of ownership.
